_comment: Lighthouse CI config for .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml.
WHAT THE `settings` BLOCK NOW CATCHES: itself not running.
This file used to say `"preset": "mobile"`. There is no such preset.
Lighthouse accepts exactly three (`perf`, `experimental`, `desktop`), so
the collector threw on startup and died in about two seconds; the
workflow's `continue-on-error: true` then converted that crash into a
green check. Every scheduled Lighthouse run from 2026-05-18 onward
finished in 13-23 seconds and reported success having measured nothing at
all. Same failure shape as the three prod incidents: a detector whose
result never reaches the exit code.
Mobile is now expressed the way Lighthouse actually takes it -- explicit
formFactor + screenEmulation + throttling, rather than a preset name.
`formFactor` and `screenEmulation.mobile` MUST agree or Lighthouse warns
and the scores are not comparable run to run. Do not reintroduce a
`preset` key here: `desktop` is the only preset that would even load, and
it would silently turn this into a desktop audit.
THRESHOLDS ARE MEASURED, NOT GUESSED. Real mobile Lighthouse 12.8.2 runs
against prod on 2026-08-31 (throttled mobile, headless Chrome):
/         perf 0.63  a11y 1.00  best-practices 1.00  seo 1.00
/browse   perf 0.65  a11y 1.00  best-practices 0.96  seo 1.00
/login    perf 0.67  a11y 1.00  best-practices 1.00  seo 1.00
/signup   perf 0.79  a11y 1.00  best-practices 0.96  seo 1.00
`categories:performance` is an `error` at 0.50 -- the workflow header has
always claimed it 'fails the run if mobile performance drops below
threshold', and now that is true. 0.50 against a measured 0.63-0.67 is
~0.13 of headroom, enough to absorb runner variance while still catching
a real regression. If this starts failing, fix the regression; do not
lower the number or demote it back to `warn`.
accessibility/best-practices stay at `warn`: a11y-axe.yml is the real
accessibility gate (WCAG 2A/2AA via axe over every screen at four
variants), and Lighthouse's category score is a weaker, noisier signal
that should not be a second, softer copy of it.
LOCAL BUILD SINCE 2026-09-14: lighthouse.yml audits this commit on
http://127.0.0.1:4173 (vite preview, gzip) instead of the deployed site, so
test traffic costs no Vercel edge requests. `canonical` is skipped because
index.html's canonical names the production host, which Lighthouse scores 0
on any other origin; the baselines above were measured on prod and the first
local run is the new baseline to compare against.
NOINDEX PAGES (Q401a, 2026-09-25): /login and /signup now serve
`robots: noindex, follow` on purpose (auth entry points, out of the
sitemap). Lighthouse's is-crawlable audit fails on noindex and takes the
SEO category to 0.63, so those two URLs are graded by assertMatrix on the
SEO audits that still apply (each at 1, not a lowered category floor)
with is-crawlable off (LHCI has no maxScore to require 0; the noindex
itself is proven by src/test/publicRoutesServeOwnHead.test.ts).
/ and /browse keep the full `categories:seo` >= 0.9 gate.
